!55 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"// Negative control for #3695.\0A//\0A// Identical to repro.hlsl except that the three invalid resource constructs the\0A// issue fingers are removed:\0A//   * blur() returns float4 instead of RWTexture2D<float4>  (no `return tex;`)\0A//   * main has no local RWTexture2D<float4> initialised from a call\0A//   * main does not assign to the global _blurResult\0A// Everything else -- the root signature, the four globals, the resource\0A// parameter, the two loops, GetDimensions -- is unchanged, so a crash here\0A// would mean the predicate is firing on something other than the reported\0A// trigger.\0A//\0A// Expected: compiles clean, exit 0, predicate must NOT match.\0A\0A#define MY_RS    \22RootFlags(0),\22  \5C\0A    \22CBV(b0), \22 \5C\0A    \22DescriptorTable(UAV(u0, numDescriptors = 3)) \22\0A\0ARWTexture2D<float4> _blurResult;\0A\0ARWTexture2D<float4> _previousResult;\0A\0ARWTexture2D<float4> _previousTarget;\0A\0Afloat _blendFactor,_blurSize, _blurDirections, _blurQuality;\0A\0Afloat4 blur(RWTexture2D<float4> tex, float2 uv, float2 stride)\0A{\0A\09float Pi = 6.28318530718; // Pi*2\0A\0A\09float2 Radius = _blurSize / stride;\0A\0A\09float4 Color = tex[uv];\0A\0A\09// Blur calculations\0A\09for (float d = 0.0; d < Pi; d += Pi / _blurDirections)\0A\09{\0A\09\09float2 angles = float2(cos(d), sin(d));\0A\0A\09\09for (float i = 1.0 / _blurQuality; i <= 1.0; i += 1.0 / _blurQuality)\0A\09\09{\0A\09\09\09Color.r += tex[uv + angles * Radius * i].r;\0A\09\09}\0A\09}\0A\0A\09float divisor = _blurQuality * _blurDirections - 15.0;\0A\09if (divisor == 0)\0A\09{\0A\09\09divisor = 0.0001;\0A\09}\0A\09Color.r /= divisor;\0A\0A\09tex[uv] = Color;\0A\0A\09return Color;\0A}\0A\0A[RootSignature(MY_RS)]\0A[numthreads(8,8,1)]\0Avoid main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)\0A{\0A\09float x, y;\0A\09_blurResult.GetDimensions(x, y);\0A\09blur(_blurResult, id.xy, float2(x, y));\0A\0A\09_previousResult[id.xy] = lerp(_previousResult[id.xy], _previousTarget[id.xy], _blendFactor);\0A}\0A"}
